source: VVOB (Vlaamse Vereniging voor Ontwikkelingssamenwerking en Technische Bijstand), Kandal Provincial Department of Agriculture extension officer booklet "ដំណាំល្ហុង" (Papaya), 2010
text:
Papaya is described as an important crop for both people and livestock. It is a source of several vitamins, including vitamin A and vitamin C, which are valuable for human health, and eating ripe papaya is noted as an aid to digestion.

In Cambodia, papaya has long been grown by farming households, historically mainly to supply the household's own consumption, with any surplus fruit sold at local markets.
